notes: 0.6.49：macOS 全面可用（本机切到 macOS 后集中修的一批 Windows 假设）。① 客户端根：isAppRoot 只认 <root>/resources，macOS 的 .app bundle 永远认不出 → AppRoot 为空、面板报「定位不到客户端根目录」、脚本生成不了。现在按 Contents/Resources 归一，并把 .app 内部路径的输入也归一回来。② 版本：app 版本与 Electron 版本写死 <root>/resources/app.asar 与 <root>/version；macOS 上 asar 在 Contents/Resources、没有 version 文件 → 两个格子恒为空、版本契约形同虚设。现在统一由 runtime/platform.mjs 读（asar 头解析 + Electron Framework 的 Info.plist）。③ 仓库路径：自动探测只试 D:/G:/C: 盘符，macOS 上必然失败；更糟的是 POSIX 上把 D:\dsh-config 当相对路径，mkdir 会在当前目录真建一个叫 D:\dsh-config 的目录（本仓库根就留了一个）。现在默认 ~/dsh-config，并按平台校验路径形状，跨平台写法当场 400 而不是静默存成别的意思。④ 退出后同步：执行体只找 post-exit.ps1，macOS 上 spawn powershell.exe 必 ENOENT → 「退出后推送/拉取/还原/更新」整条链路死掉，面板只显示排队中。新增 runtime/post-exit.mjs（等 pid → 跑引擎 → 写 auto-sync-result.json → 可选重启），锁文件两个平台共用。⑤ 自更新：运行中安装只找 install-plugin.ps1。新增 runtime/install-plugin.mjs（下载 → sha256/sha1/integrity 校验 → 用 zlib 自己解 npm tarball → 备份 → 覆盖 → 失败回滚），输出与 PowerShell 版同形的 RESULT:{json}。⑥ 首次拉取：Node 引擎没有 Windows 版 Initialize-RepoIfNeeded 的等价物，全新目录 pull 必停在「fatal: no such branch: 'main'」然后拿空仓库照跑一遍 —— 结果「拉取成功、什么都没落地」。现在先 ls-remote 取默认分支、fetch、无提交时 checkout -B 跟踪远端。⑦ 仓库自愈：POSIX 的 capture 只写内容不写执行体，第一次推送成功后仓库立刻被判成「不像仓库」并禁掉后续动作。现在 capture 把 sync-engine.mjs 及依赖模块写进仓库根（Windows 版一直这么干）。⑧ 还原脚本：POSIX 版是裸调一次 restore —— 不显示用的是哪份快照、不 dry-run、不确认，响应里也没有 backup 字段。现在与 .cmd 版对齐：快照信息 → 引擎 -DryRun → 确认 → 真跑，并返回 backup。⑨ 面板：仓库路径占位符、post-exit 名称、~/.dsh 路径随平台显示，不再一律写 D:\ 与 .cmd。⑩ 自检：tools/selftest.mjs 不再往用户真实 ~/.dsh 里写测试值（改成临时隔离 DSH_HOME + 夹具，--in-place 才连真机），并新增 22 条平台回归断言；原来是「跑完靠备份还原兜底」，中途崩一次就把用户配置留在测试值上。⑪ 云端目标卡：在「什么云端都还没配」时会强制进入编辑态，但 activeMode 只认 editing、不认这个强制态 —— 选了 WebDAV 后字段不跟着切（还显示 Git 的远端地址 / SSH 私钥），保存时按 webdav 校验，报「请填写 WebDAV 地址」，而那个输入框根本不在页面上（用户实测截图）。现在由 isEditing 决定，强制态也跟随下拉框；同时选了 WebDAV 就不再回写 git 设置，免得先前填在「远端地址」里的 DAV 地址被当成 git 远端存下去、set-url 失败后整套回滚。⑫ 安全：私钥拦截名单只有 dsh-ssh-master.key 这类自家名字，ssh-keygen 的默认产物 id_ed25519 / id_rsa / *.ppk 是裸名，既无 .key 后缀也不在名单里 —— 用户把 ~/.ssh 加进额外路径就会把私钥原样传上云端（WebDAV 自检实测抓到）。现在按名字（id_rsa/id_dsa/id_ecdsa/id_ed25519(_sk)/identity/*.ppk）与内容（PEM / PuTTY 私钥头）双重拦截，上传侧与 capture 侧共用同一份正则，不再各写一套。⑬ 新增 tools/webdav-selftest.mjs：进程内起一个最小 WebDAV 服务器（真 HTTP / 真 XML / 真落盘、只连 127.0.0.1），覆盖首次上传逐级 MKCOL、按 sha256 判重（同长度不同内容必须重传）、冲突留底、空云端、不可达服务器、明文地址闸门，24 条断言，已接入 package.json 的 verify 与 CI。⑭ 后台自动拉取：启动 8 秒后的首检在 macOS 上也会弹 osascript 原生确认框，而那条路径既没有请求也没有面板 —— 框常常落在应用窗口后面甚至不出现在前台，用户看不见就等于「自动拉取永远不会发生」，DSH 还一直以为在等确认。现在 POSIX 只在 status.auto.pullPrompt 里挂提示（并写logs/auto-sync-pull-prompt.log），面板显示「云端领先 N 个提交，请点立即拉取」，排队或拉平后自动清除；Windows 保持原 MessageBox。面板侧的 /config-sync/auto 调用也收口到一处 autoFetch，支持两段式确认（宿主回 needConfirm → 面板自己问 → 带 confirmed:true 重发），用户点取消不抛错而显示「已取消」。⑮ 符号链接形式的仓库路径：macOS 上 /var 与 /tmp 都指向 /private/var、/private/tmp，`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` 报的是真实路径，而引擎拿用户填的路径去比字面量 —— 只要仓库在一个符号链接目录下（/tmp/dsh-config，或把仓库链到外置盘），推送/拉取一进门就报「这个目录不是仓库根」，面板的「立即推送」直接失败（新自检实测抓到）。现在两边都 realpath 一次再比，任一边解析失败退回字面量。⑯ 同步范围卡说实话：非 Windows 的引擎只同步 profile / 提示 / Skills / 预设四组，但范围卡照样列出十二组、勾选也照样能点 —— 用户勾上「会话记录」却永远不生效（待推送计数其实已经按四组算了，所以界面上是「待推送 0」+「勾选着会话记录」这种自相矛盾）。现在 GET /scope 给每组带 supported，不支持的组禁用心选框并标注「此平台暂不支持」。⑰ 会话记录进 macOS / Linux 引擎：这一组以前只有 Windows 的 PowerShell 会做，换了 Mac 之后勾着「会话记录」等于勾着好看。现在 Node 引擎按同一套目录命名（已登记工作区用 --ws-<工作区ID>--，im 用 --im--，认不出的原名穿透）抓取 sessions / attachments / session_projcache / vision_router_session_policy 四块数据，写 session-index.json，换机按本机工作区 ID 重新编码目录名；会话日志走 seq 护栏（两台机器各 append 一段时不会互相覆盖出 seq gap），护栏不可用时退回整文件覆盖并在面板写明。默认工作区始终不参与同步。⑱ 插件数据 / 额外路径也进 Node 引擎：这两组的规则（单文件上限、排除通配、跳过的目录、安全必需项）原先只写在面板代码里，引擎不知道也就抓不了。现在规则收进 runtime/extra-rules.mjs，面板与引擎共用一份，引擎按同一套规则抓 plugin-data/<槽>/ 与 extra/<id>/（含 manifest.json），apply 按占位符回到本机路径。顺手修掉「每次 capture 都重写所有文本文件」：内容归一后没变就不写，也不再谎报「本轮改了 N 个文件」。⑲ profile 组补上 `cordis.yml` 与 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`：前者是「哪些插件开着」的名单，丢了换台机器就不是同一套插件；后者是 hoisted 布局。Windows 版一直抓这两个，Node 引擎之前只抓 package.json / cordis.patch.yml / 两个 lock 文件。入库前同样做占位符化，apply 时展开成本机路径。⑳「插件设置与工作流」进 Node 引擎：14 个插件各自的配置文件（清单收进 runtime/settings-sources.mjs，面板与引擎共用一份），逐个文件抓取而不是整目录（周围都是 .db / 缓存 / 会话）；our-free-model 的 catalogSyncedAt / reloadCount 这类每秒刷新的字段清零，否则每次抓取都「有改动」。凭据嗅探也提到共用模块 runtime/extra-rules.mjs：名字（.env / *.pem / *.key / 自家私有 json）与内容（GitHub 令牌前缀、accessToken / apiKey / password 等字段名、PEM / PuTTY 头）两道门，读不出来的文件一律当凭据 —— 之前 settings 组会把带 apiKey 的配置文件原样入仓。㉑ 又补三组进 Node 引擎：技能市场台账（storages-record，两个小 json）、记忆数据（mnemon，`<AppRoot>/mnemon` 整棵 + 镜像删除）、本地源码插件（local-plugins，profile 里 `link:` 指向的目录打包成 `local-plugins/<名字>.zip`）。打包走新写的 runtime/zip.mjs（只用 node:zlib，不引第三方），跳过 .git / node_modules / releases / .cache 与凭据文件，顶层必须是 `<名字>/package.json`（否则换个机器解出坏目录）；换机 apply 解到 `<DshHome>/local-plugins-restore/<名字>/`，由用户重新 link —— 不硬写进客户端包（macOS 上那是签名过的 .app）。另修：源码文件里出现 "apikey" 这类**字段名字样**不再算凭据（本仓库自己的 selftest 因此被打包跳过过），真实 GitHub 令牌与私钥头照拦；需要豁免时可在文件里写 dsh-sync-allow-secret。㉒ 最后一组「工作区资料」也进 Node 引擎，但**只同步登记表**（mode: registry-only）：仓库里写 `workspace/workspace-registry.json`（工作区 id / 标题 / 槽名 / 占位符化路径 / 会话 id / 钉住 / 默认工作区），**不搬工作区里的文件树** —— 实测这台机器 5 个登记工作区里 `~/projects` 就 1.9 GB，全搬等于把 NAS 当网盘。还原时按 id 合并进 `storages/workspace.json`（本机已有的工作区一律不动、只补缺的，写前留底），并把云端清单另存一份 `workspace-from-cloud.json` 供参考；`settings` 组里那份整份快照这时跳过，避免两处打架。至此 12 组在 macOS / Linux 上全部支持。㉓ 跨平台拉取护栏：仓库是另一套系统传上去的时候，`profile/package.json`、`profile/cordis.patch.yml`、`prompt/AGENTS.md` **一律不覆盖本机**，只摊到 `<DshHome>/profile-from-cloud/` 与 `<DshHome>/prompt-from-cloud/`，面板写明原因（判据：契约里的 platformFamily、package.json 里的盘符/AppData、cordis.patch.yml 里的 `X:\`）。实测 Windows 仓库里 `"@local/dsh-personal": "link:{{ROOT:userHome}}/AppData/Local/dsh-personal"` 会在 macOS 上展开成不存在的路径，pnpm 解不出来、profile 起不来 —— 这条护栏挡的就是它。工作区登记表合并也会跳过本机形态不合法的路径。㉔ 真机拉取实测补一刀：`settings` 组里那份「整份工作区登记表」在跨平台时也不铺 —— 实测被 Windows 机器的快照覆盖后，本机 21 个工作区里 19 个是 `D:\project\...`（本机原来的 5 个被顶掉，面板里多出一堆点开就报错的行）。现在跨平台直接跳过并说明；同平台仍按原样铺。㉕ 跨平台移植（`runtime/porting.mjs`）：拉回来的另一套系统配置不再只是「摊到暂存目录」，而是**改成本机能用的样子**。路径翻译按优先级找对应物（`config-sync-port.json` 映射表 → `%USERPROFILE%`/`%LOCALAPPDATA%` → WSL `/mnt/c/...` → `C:\Users\<U>` → 同名工作区 / `~/projects/<同名>` / `~/<同名>` / `~/Documents/<同名>`），一个都命中不了才放弃。`profile/package.json` 走「本机优先 + link 改写 + 不可装的丢弃」合并（`link:` 目标目录必须真有 `package.json`，`file:` 的 tgz 不在仓库里就丢），bundles 同步收敛；工作区登记表翻译后按 id 合并，同名去重、家目录本身不当工作区；`prompt/AGENTS.md` 翻译路径后放进 `prompt-from-cloud/`（本机已有自己那份就不覆盖）。实测云端那份 Windows profile 合并后 42 个依赖 `pnpm install --lockfile-only` 全解析通过。另：推送后自动删云端的历史浏览器剖面（`plugin-data/browser-profiles`，含 Login Data / Cookies），不用用户自己找。㉖ 修「覆盖前留底」形同虚设：几处 `backupBeforeWrite(dst, dst)` 把目标文件跟它自己比，永远判「内容相同」→ 备份根本没做（真机上覆盖 profile/package.json 时一点痕迹都没留）。改成传仓库那份作比对、本机那份作复制，并补断言钉住。㉗ 仓库自带执行体补齐：原先只往仓库里放 6 个 `.mjs`，0.6.49 新增的组用到的 `zip.mjs` / `extra-rules.mjs` / `settings-sources.mjs` / `porting.mjs` 和会话护栏 `tools/session-log-*.mjs` 没跟着走 —— 另一台机器没有插件副本时，拿仓库里那份跑 apply 会 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`，或者静默降级成「不比对会话日志」。现在一次推齐，且内容没变不重写。㉘ 平台分区：机器相关的文件按平台分目录存，**一份仓库三端共用**。`profile/<平台>/`（package.json、cordis.patch.yml、cordis.yml、pnpm-*.yaml、host-contract.json）、`prompt/<平台>/AGENTS.md`、`settings/<平台>/dsh-workspaces.json`，平台取 `process.platform`（win32 / darwin / linux）。读的时候本平台优先，没有才回落到根目录那份老位置（回落到老位置就按移植层处理）；根目录那份**只读不写**，留给还没升级的老客户端 —— 两边各写各的，谁也不覆盖谁。插件数据槽另外硬拦 `profile-from-cloud` / `prompt-from-cloud` / `local-plugins-restore`（自己产出的暂存目录不该被当成别人的插件数据再传上去，实测会被当成槽抓进 manifest）。㉙ 共享配置改成真正的「互相覆盖」：`skills` / `presets` 拉取时按云端镜像 —— 仓库里没有的本机条目会被删掉（删前留底到 `backups/apply-*`），否则在一台机器上删掉的技能永远删不掉，两边越用越分叉。全局提示 `prompt/AGENTS.md` 从平台分区回到共享（提示是配置，三端要一致），早期版本写出来的 `prompt/<平台>/AGENTS.md` 会在下次抓取时清掉。㉚ 全局提示按平台分开存（用户选择 B）：`prompt/<平台>/AGENTS.md`。理由是里面写的是各系统的运行时路径与 shell 命令 —— 共享一份的话，Mac 推一次就把 Windows 的 `pwsh` 路由换成 macOS 的 `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/...`，反之亦然。技能、预设、模型设置、插件数据、会话、工作区登记表仍然共享并互相覆盖。㉛ 契约按平台读：`profile/<平台>/host-contract.json` 优先，根目录那份（老客户端写的，缺 platforms/platformFamily）只在没有分区副本时用。之前 macOS 上读到的是 Windows 那份不完整契约，`status` 里 platforms/platformFamily 全是空，面板会误报「契约缺失」。
notesEn: 0.6.49: macOS is fully supported (a batch of Windows-only assumptions fixed after this machine moved to macOS). (1) Client root: isAppRoot only accepted <root>/resources, so a macOS .app bundle never matched -> AppRoot empty, the panel reported "cannot locate the client root directory" and no script could be generated. It now normalises through Contents/Resources and also accepts a .app-internal path as input. (2) Versions: the app and Electron versions were read from <root>/resources/app.asar and <root>/version; on macOS the asar lives in Contents/Resources and there is no version file -> both fields empty forever. Both now come from runtime/platform.mjs (asar header parsing plus the Electron Framework Info.plist). (3) Repo path: auto-detection only tried D:/G:/C:, which cannot work on macOS; worse, on POSIX "D:\\dsh-config" was treated as a relative path and mkdir really created such a directory in the cwd. Default is now ~/dsh-config, path shapes are validated per platform, and a cross-platform path is rejected with 400 instead of being silently reinterpreted. (4) Sync after exit: the runner only looked for post-exit.ps1, so spawning powershell.exe failed with ENOENT and the whole "push / pull / restore / update after you quit" chain died while the panel kept saying queued. Added runtime/post-exit.mjs (wait for pid -> run engine -> write auto-sync-result.json -> optional relaunch); the lock file is shared by both platforms. (5) Self-update: in-process install only looked for install-plugin.ps1. Added runtime/install-plugin.mjs (download -> sha256/sha1/integrity verify -> own zlib tarball extraction -> backup -> overwrite -> rollback on failure) emitting the same RESULT:{json}. (6) First pull on a new machine: the Node engine had no equivalent of the Windows Initialize-RepoIfNeeded, so pulling into a fresh directory stopped at "fatal: no such branch: 'main'" and then ran against an empty repo -- "pull succeeded, nothing landed". It now takes the default branch from ls-remote, fetches, and checks out a tracking branch when there are no commits. (7) Repo self-heal: the POSIX capture wrote content but not the runner files, so right after the first successful push the repo was judged "not a repo" and every later action was disabled. capture now writes sync-engine.mjs and its modules into the repo root, as the Windows path always did. (8) Restore script: the POSIX variant was a bare restore call -- no snapshot info, no dry run, no confirmation, and no backup field in the response. It now matches the .cmd script: snapshot info -> engine -DryRun -> confirm -> real run, and the response carries backup. (9) Panel: repo-path placeholder, post-exit runner name and the ~/.dsh path follow the platform instead of always showing D:\\ and .cmd. (10) Self-test: tools/selftest.mjs no longer writes test values into the real ~/.dsh (it builds an isolated DSH_HOME plus fixtures; --in-place opts into the real machine) and gained 22 platform regression assertions -- it used to rely on restore-from-backup, so one crash mid-run left the user's config on test values. (11) Cloud target card: when nothing is configured yet the card forces edit mode, but activeMode only honoured `editing`, not that forced state -- picking WebDAV left the Git fields on screen (remote URL / SSH key) and Save then validated as webdav and reported "please fill in the WebDAV address" for an input that was not even rendered (reported by a user with a screenshot). activeMode now derives from isEditing, and saving in WebDAV mode no longer writes git settings, so an address typed into the Git field is not stored as a git remote and rolled back on set-url failure. (12) Security: the private-key blocklist only had our own names such as dsh-ssh-master.key, while ssh-keygen's default output (id_ed25519 / id_rsa / *.ppk) is a bare name with no .key suffix -- adding ~/.ssh as an extra path would upload the private key verbatim (caught by the new WebDAV self-test). Keys are now blocked by name (id_rsa/id_dsa/id_ecdsa/id_ed25519(_sk)/identity/*.ppk) and by content (PEM / PuTTY private-key headers), and the upload path and capture share one set of regexes instead of two drifting copies. (13) New tools/webdav-selftest.mjs: starts a minimal WebDAV server in-process (real HTTP, real XML, real disk, 127.0.0.1 only) and covers first upload with per-level MKCOL, sha256-based dedupe (same length different content must be re-uploaded), conflict backups, empty cloud, unreachable server and the plaintext-URL gate -- 24 assertions, wired into package.json verify and CI. (14) Background auto-pull: the first check 8 s after startup also tried to pop the osascript dialog on macOS, and that path has neither a request nor a panel -- the dialog usually lands behind the app window or never reaches the foreground, so the user never sees it and auto-pull simply never happens while DSH believes it is still waiting for confirmation. On POSIX it now only records status.auto.pullPrompt (plus logs/auto-sync-pull-prompt.log) and the panel shows "the cloud is N commits ahead -- click Pull now"; the prompt clears once a pull is queued or the sides match. Windows keeps the MessageBox. Panel calls to /config-sync/auto also go through one autoFetch helper with a two-phase confirm (host answers needConfirm -> panel asks -> resend with confirmed:true), and cancelling reports "cancelled" instead of throwing. (15) Repo paths that go through a symlink: on macOS /var and /tmp point at /private/var and /private/tmp, while `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` reports the resolved path -- the engine compared it literally against the path the user typed, so any repo living under a symlinked directory (/tmp/dsh-config, or a repo linked to an external disk) failed immediately with "this directory is not the repo root" and the panel's live push broke (caught by the new self-test). Both sides are now realpath'd before comparing, falling back to the literal value if either cannot be resolved. (16) The sync-scope card now tells the truth: on non-Windows the engine handles only profile / prompt / skills / presets, yet the card still listed all twelve groups with live checkboxes, so a user could tick "conversations" and nothing would ever happen (the pending counter already counted only four groups, which made the panel self-contradictory: "nothing pending" next to a ticked conversations group). GET /scope now reports supported per group, and unsupported ones are disabled and labelled "not on this platform". (17) Conversations now sync on macOS / Linux too: this group used to be PowerShell-only, so on a Mac ticking "conversations" meant nothing. The Node engine now captures the same four blocks (sessions, attachments, session_projcache, vision_router_session_policy) under the same stable directory names (--ws-<workspaceId>-- for registered workspaces, --im--, passthrough otherwise), writes session-index.json, and re-encodes directory names for the target machine's workspace paths on apply. Session logs go through the seq guard so two machines appending to the same session cannot overwrite each other into a seq gap; if the guard is unavailable it falls back to a whole-file copy and says so in the panel. The default workspace is never synced. (18) Plugin data and extra paths now sync on macOS / Linux too. Their rules (per-file cap, exclude globs, skipped dirs, safety-mandatory entries) used to live only in the panel code, so the engine could not apply them; they now live in runtime/extra-rules.mjs shared by both, and the engine captures plugin-data/<slot>/ and extra/<id>/ (with manifest.json) under the same rules, expanding placeholders back to local paths on apply. Also fixed: every capture used to rewrite all text files and report "N files changed" — unchanged content is no longer written. (19) The profile group now includes cordis.yml (the list of enabled plugins — without it a new machine ends up with a different plugin set) and pnpm-workspace.yaml (hoisted layout). The Windows scripts always captured these two; the Node engine only took package.json, cordis.patch.yml and the two lockfiles. They are tokenised on capture and expanded back to this machine's paths on apply. (20) The "plugin settings and workflows" group now syncs on macOS / Linux: the 14 per-plugin config files (list in runtime/settings-sources.mjs, shared with the panel) are captured file by file rather than directory-wise, because the surrounding tree is full of .db files, caches and sessions. Volatile fields such as our-free-model's catalogSyncedAt / reloadCount are zeroed so a capture is not "changed" every single time. Secret sniffing moved into the shared runtime/extra-rules.mjs with two gates — name (.env / *.pem / *.key / private json) and content (GitHub token prefixes, accessToken / apiKey / password keys, PEM / PuTTY headers) — and anything unreadable counts as secret: before this, the settings group would commit a config file containing an apiKey verbatim. (21) Three more groups on macOS / Linux: the skill-market ledger (storages-record, two small json files), memory data (mnemon, the whole <AppRoot>/mnemon tree plus mirror deletion) and local source plugins (local-plugins: directories referenced by `link:` in the profile get packed into local-plugins/<name>.zip). Packing uses a new runtime/zip.mjs built on node:zlib only, skips .git / node_modules / releases / .cache and secret files, and requires <name>/package.json at the archive root so the other machine cannot extract a broken nested directory. On apply the archive is extracted to <DshHome>/local-plugins-restore/<name>/ for the user to link, never written into the client bundle (a signed .app on macOS). Also fixed: source files that merely mention field names like "apikey" are no longer treated as credentials (our own selftest was being dropped from the plugin zip); real GitHub tokens and private-key headers are still blocked, and a file may opt out with dsh-sync-allow-secret. (22) The last group, workspace, is now supported on macOS / Linux too, but registry-only (mode: registry-only): the repo gets workspace/workspace-registry.json (id, title, slot, tokenised path, session ids, pinned ids, default workspace) and **no workspace file trees** — on this machine one registered workspace alone is 1.9 GB, so copying them would turn the NAS into a file host. Restore merges by id into storages/workspace.json (existing local workspaces untouched, missing ones added, backup taken first) and keeps a reference copy in workspace-from-cloud.json; the whole-file snapshot in the settings group is skipped in that case so the two sources cannot fight. All twelve groups are now supported on macOS / Linux. (23) Cross-platform pull guard: when the repo came from another OS, profile/package.json, profile/cordis.patch.yml and prompt/AGENTS.md are **never written over the local machine**; they are laid out in <DshHome>/profile-from-cloud/ and <DshHome>/prompt-from-cloud/ with a panel note explaining why (evidence: platformFamily in the contract, drive letters / AppData in package.json, `X:\` in cordis.patch.yml). Verified against a real Windows repo whose `"@local/dsh-personal": "link:{{ROOT:userHome}}/AppData/Local/dsh-personal"` would expand to a non-existent macOS path and break the profile. Workspace-registry merging also skips paths that cannot exist here. (24) After a real pull test: the whole-file workspace registry in the settings group is now skipped for cross-platform repos too. It had replaced the local registry with 21 entries, 19 of them `D:\project\...` paths, and the local five were gone. Cross-platform pulls now skip it with an explanation; same-platform pulls behave as before. (25) Cross-platform porting (runtime/porting.mjs): a pull from another OS no longer just parks files aside — it rewrites them into something usable here. Path translation tries, in order: the map in config-sync-port.json, %USERPROFILE%/%LOCALAPPDATA%, WSL /mnt/c/..., C:\Users\<U>, then same-name workspace / ~/projects/<name> / ~/<name> / ~/Documents/<name>, giving up only when nothing exists. profile/package.json is merged local-first with link: targets rewritten and anything uninstallable dropped (a link: dir must really contain package.json, a file: tgz absent from the repo is dropped), and bundles are pruned to match; the workspace registry is translated and merged by id (same-name entries deduped, the home directory itself never becomes a workspace); prompt/AGENTS.md is translated into prompt-from-cloud/ and only replaces a local file that is itself a previous port. The real Windows profile merged to 42 dependencies that pnpm install --lockfile-only resolves cleanly. Pushing now also deletes the legacy plugin-data/browser-profiles tree (Login Data / Cookies) from the cloud. (26) Fixed a no-op backup: several call sites passed backupBeforeWrite(dst, dst), comparing the target file with itself, so it always decided "unchanged" and never copied anything (a real pull overwrote profile/package.json leaving no trace). It now compares against the repo copy and copies the local one, with an assertion to keep it that way. (27) The repo now carries everything the engine imports: the six .mjs files it used to ship were missing zip.mjs, extra-rules.mjs, settings-sources.mjs, porting.mjs and the session guard (tools/session-log-*.mjs), so another machine without a plugin copy would hit ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND or silently skip the session-log comparison. All of it ships now, and unchanged files are not rewritten. (28) Platform lanes: machine-specific files now live under a per-platform directory so **one repo serves all three clients**. profile/<platform>/ (package.json, cordis.patch.yml, cordis.yml, pnpm-*.yaml, host-contract.json), prompt/<platform>/AGENTS.md and settings/<platform>/dsh-workspaces.json, where platform is process.platform (win32 / darwin / linux). Reads prefer the local lane and fall back to the legacy root location (which then goes through the porting layer); the root files are read-only for us, left to clients that have not upgraded yet, so neither side overwrites the other. Plugin-data slots additionally hard-skip profile-from-cloud / prompt-from-cloud / local-plugins-restore, since our own staging output was otherwise captured as somebody's plugin data (it showed up in the manifest). (29) Shared config now really overwrites: pulling skills / presets mirrors the cloud, so local entries that no longer exist in the repo are deleted (copied into backups/apply-* first) — otherwise a skill removed on one machine could never be removed on another and the two would drift apart. prompt/AGENTS.md moved back from a per-platform lane to shared (instructions are config and should match on every client), and a stale prompt/<platform>/AGENTS.md from the earlier layout is cleaned up on the next capture. (30) The global prompt is per-platform again (option B chosen): prompt/<platform>/AGENTS.md. It carries each system's runtime paths and shell commands, so sharing one copy meant a Mac push would replace the Windows pwsh routing with macOS ~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes paths and vice versa. Skills, presets, model settings, plugin data, sessions and the workspace registry stay shared and overwrite each other. (31) The contract is read per platform: profile/<platform>/host-contract.json wins, and the root copy (written by older clients, missing platforms/platformFamily) is only a fallback. On macOS the reader used to pick the incomplete Windows file, leaving platforms/platformFamily empty in status and making the panel claim the contract was missing.
